content.text: Found and fixed it: src/config.go never set the Port default, so it stayed at the zero value instead of 8080 whenever PORT was unset. Added the default; TestConfigDefaultPort now passes. git diff --stat shows exactly the one line changed. Separately, src/main.go's only real logic is computeChecksumForge, an FNV-1a style hash used to dedupe ingested documents — untouched by this fix. There are still 6 outstanding TODOs about retry backoff scattered across the service files if you want those next.
